collection.description: A castaway asks to join the village but refuses to explain their past.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A castaway asks to become part of the village but refuses to explain their past.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The newcomer helps repair nets and slowly builds trust.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: The visitor agrees to shared rules but keeps personal history private.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: They leave gratefully; later, an unfamiliar gift appears onshore.
